scope: Separate assistant implementation contexts with cross-module review; not external human approval or full-product independent signoff.

implementation_owners./root/review_core: C++ SiteRegistry, durable map queue, schema 5, budgets, receipts, cache/origin state, native tests, CLI and CMake/CI wiring.
implementation_owners./root/review_service: Python robots and site policy, one-hop fetch, actual-dispatch checks, private RPC and worker tests.
implementation_owners./root/handoff_requirements: Pure bounded discovery parser and tests; planning README and current slice metadata.
implementation_owners./root: Integration, MCP/config/launcher, controlled site server and process E2E, current status/docs and final recorded validation.

resolved_findings.problem: Default client URL canonicalization could rewrite encoded path/query after admission; discovery also needed the complete HTTP charset header.
resolved_findings.resolution: Core, pure discovery and worker preserve the ASCII path/query representation; encoded=True is used only after NetPolicy authority validation. Full Content-Type is passed to discovery.

resolved_findings.problem: An optional unsafe link or robots Sitemap declaration could fail a whole otherwise valid discovery response.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate required response structure, then filter optional URLs individually in the core and count filtered_urls. Actual request scope and NetPolicy checks remain mandatory.

resolved_findings.problem: Checking only the logical entry deletion generation omitted deletion of the current redirect target while its response was in flight.
resolved_findings.resolution: Persist current target_generation in admission and compare both logical and actual target generations at the live lease and transactional publication fences.

resolved_findings.problem: Canonical history URLs could lose the original document deletion identity, including uppercase hosts, default ports or fragments.
resolved_findings.resolution: Persist original history document_id and delete generation; verify owner and visibility before insertion and in rows, next-page and visible-total queries. Reimport cannot revive old candidates.

resolved_findings.problem: A permitting robots cache record could outlive explicit freshness when Age, Date, Expires or malformed cache metadata was ignored.
resolved_findings.resolution: Conservatively subtract upstream age and request elapsed time, enforce explicit absolute expiry, and deny reuse on invalid metadata, no-store/no-cache, zero freshness or unsupported Vary. No stale allow fallback or 304 claim.

resolved_findings.problem: Cross-process bounds/types for robots and discovery receipts disagreed; null HTTP status on a zero-dispatch refusal could erase the original error.
resolved_findings.resolution: Align strict record, rule and diagnostic bounds. Require dispatch-bound robots proof for actual content requests; permit error/null with known zero usage and retain the refusal code. Parse trusted usage before rejecting malformed artifacts.

resolved_findings.problem: worker_args could override the shared sites path, leaving core and worker with different files and making map unusable despite a seemingly configured launcher.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reject --sites, its argparse long-option prefixes and equals forms before starting either process. Preserve legitimate additional worker arguments.

cross_reviews.scope: C++ discovery contract, union URL caps, query variants, lease settlement, history owner/deletion and target fences.
cross_reviews.method: Read-only counterexample review and final static confirmation. Native/process tests were executed separately by root; the reviewer ran its own pure parser tests.
cross_reviews.conclusion: Both independent candidate-isolation/history findings were fixed; no additional blocker identified in the examined scope.

cross_reviews.scope: Worker robots freshness, repeated headers, actual-dispatch decision and zero/null refusals.
cross_reviews.method: Read-only cross-review after worker changes; no new tests or code changes during this review.
cross_reviews.conclusion: Freshness can only shorten permission and dispatch is rechecked after queue waits. Retired replay error categorization remains an explicit non-blocking diagnostic limit.

cross_reviews.scope: Root config/launcher, MCP omission versus zero, shared policy path, private fields and actual E2E manifest rejection.
cross_reviews.method: Read-only review, a concrete launcher override finding, then read-only confirmation of the fix including option abbreviations.
cross_reviews.conclusion: The shared-path override is fixed before process creation; no residual override or additional blocker identified.

cross_reviews.scope: Core/worker RPC bounds, persistent grants/publication, URL identity and robots cache freshness; integrated HTTP/CLI/MCP processes.
cross_reviews.method: Cross-author code review plus final recorded CTest, sanitizer, launcher and metadata validation.
cross_reviews.conclusion: Seven grouped integration findings fixed and checked in the final tree; this remains a limited implementation increment.

known_nonblocking_limits.description: A retired internal attempt replay keeps historical usage but lacks the original robots_decision. Core can classify its E_ATTEMPT_REPLAY/E_CANCELLED as E_WORKER_PROTOCOL.
known_nonblocking_limits.impact: Diagnostic categorization only on an internal path the current core does not automatically replay. Usage is still charged and no candidate is published.
known_nonblocking_limits.verification: Static review plus existing separate worker retired-accounting and core protocol-refusal tests; no claim of a dedicated end-to-end retired replay test.

execution_evidence: ctest-final.log, four asan-*.log files, launcher_smoke.json and adjacent command records.
